profile.headline: Senior Frontend Developer
profile.summary: Frontend developer with a focus on design and accessibility.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Utilized SASS, Javascript, Freemarker, and Java to develop and maintain the frontend on Liferay’s primary marketing website: https://www.liferay.com.
* Built a GatsbyJS (React.js, GraphQl, Webpack, Node.js), Netlify-hosted documentation site for Liferay Marketing by transforming internal Google Drive documents and data into an easily-navigable web app, while also contributing to open-source projects to finish this project.
* Architected and migrated https://www.liferay.com’s SASS-based theme and atomically designed component library to streamline landing page development for Liferay’s Marketing department, significantly reducing ticket request times.
* Used Scrum processes through JIRA ticketing system to quickly accomplish tasks within two week sprints.
* Worked with stakeholders in Marketing, Design, Training, Sales, and Consulting departments to deliver landing pages and marketing sites.

positions.title: UI Intern
positions.description:
* Developed Liferay themes using modern Frontend Technologies such as node.js, npm, SASS, Liferay-specific technology: Metal.js, Clay/Lexicon, and balanced it all through Java.
* Backported and fixed bugs in Liferay versions 6.2.x, 7.0, 7.1
* Fixed various bugs on https://liferay.com
